_comment: Curated Family -> Creator (SPDX originator: the lab that TRAINED the weights) dimension. DISTINCT from Provider (the SPDX supplier/distributor). DATA-DRIVEN seed read by loadCreatorTable (parse/data glob); loud-at-codegen via ValidateCreatorTable, graceful-at-runtime via loadCreatorTableSafe (lineage.go / datasources.json precedent). Family -> Creator is a FUNCTION (BCNF): each family appears at most once; an unmapped family is expressed by OMITTING its row (Family.Creator returns CreatorNone), never a row with an empty creator. Every 'family' must satisfy Family.IsKnown. Rows are grouped by PROVENANCE below and each group is sorted by family; the grouping is documentation only -- the loader treats the array as one flat relation.
_provenance_hand_curated: Group 1 -- the original hand-curated seed, the UAT-confirmed lab mappings 'as listed'. A row here WINS over any lab-derived value for the same family (curated-over-derived): 'glm' stays CreatorZhipu ('zhipu') even though the models.dev lab prefix for that organization spells itself 'zhipuai'. Six rows in this group (claude-haiku, claude-opus, claude-sonnet, command-a, command-r, o) are DEAD -- they map compound/retired families that canonicalization no longer routes any catalog entity to. They are RETAINED deliberately, on the same rationale family.go gives for keeping FamilyO in CanonicalProvider: the tokens are still real raw_family values the upstream catalog emits, so a residual or future row carrying one still resolves to its lab instead of falling through to CreatorNone. Their zero-entity status is pinned by a test, so 'dead' is measured rather than assumed.
_provenance_lab_derived: Group 2 -- derived from the models.dev metadata LAB PREFIX. Every models.dev metadata id is lab-scoped ('<lab>/<model>'); the join's own decomposition maps that row to a family (a curated modelsdev_aliases.json entry is the SOLE identity when one exists, else stripMetadataLab + ParseFamilyDetailed, exactly as metadataEntityRef does). A family reached by EXACTLY ONE lab seeds that lab as its Creator. Families reached by more than one lab, and families whose lab disagrees with an existing curated row, are NOT auto-applied: they are reported to parse/data/creators_lab_disagreements.json for manual triage. 'ling' is likewise WITHHELD -- its only lab-scoped row reaches it through an alias that retargets thinkingmachines/inkling onto the 'ling' family, a three-way collision a later curation slice splits; seeding it now would attribute InclusionAI's Ling line to the wrong lab.
_provenance_hand_curated_unreached: Group 3 -- hand-curated rows for families the metadata join never reaches. A family with catalog entities but no models.json row has no lab prefix to derive from, so its originator must be authored. These are the largest such families; the long tail (152 of 254 catalog families carry exactly one entity, and many of those tokens are decomposition artifacts like 'free', 'cheap' or 'coder') is deliberately left unattributed rather than guessed at. Families under active re-keying by other curation work (cogito, kling/ling/ring) are deliberately omitted here so this seed does not collide with them.
_withheld: Families the lab derivation reaches but whose lab is deliberately NOT applied, with the reason. A withheld family is reported to parse/data/creators_lab_disagreements.json on every regen so the deferral stays visible instead of decaying into an unexplained gap; it is NOT the same thing as an unmapped family (which simply has no row anywhere and no report line).

withheld.reason: The only lab-scoped metadata row reaching this family reaches it through a curated alias that retargets thinkingmachines/inkling onto 'ling'. Applying the derivation would attribute InclusionAI's Ling line to Thinking Machines. The inkling/ling/kling three-way collision is split by a later curation slice, which adds the correct creator once the families are distinct.
